No test files in PR — Stage 5 must add coverage before merge.
TLS verification is not explicitly enabled in requests.post() call to SSO validation endpoint. Add verify=True to ensure TLS certificate validation.
requested_value allows float which could introduce floating-point precision issues for monetary amounts. Consider restricting to int (pence) or Decimal.
Date range validation does not check that date_from <= date_to, allowing negative ranges.
No unit tests provided for any of the three endpoints or helper functions.
Audit record is logged but new limit is not actually persisted (TODO). Returning 'approved' with no state change is a logic bug if deployed as-is.
get_payment_limits is a read-only endpoint but does not audit access. Consider audit-logging access to sensitive financial data for compliance.
